findings.detail: execute_existing calls pytest.fail when the target branch has no native file and strict mode is enabled. A comprehensive cross-branch catalog therefore cannot run cleanly against main in strict mode.
findings.fix: Generate branch-specific wrappers or mark absent-on-branch tests as explicit not-applicable skips independent of strictness.
findings.summary: Strict main-branch runs fail an experimental-only wrapper instead of treating it as not applicable
